title: Sharplink text reveal
description: Text that assembles itself as you scroll: letters fade in in a scattered order (or brighten from 35%), or words light up one after another, scrubbed with the scroll by a CSS view timeline. Static HTML shows the full text.
notes: CSS scroll-driven animation: browsers without view timelines, and reduced motion, show the text as is
pass `timeline` to follow a named view timeline of a parent (e.g. a pinned stage) instead of the text's own
name: sharplink-text-reveal

props.name: text
props.description: the text; a line break ("\n") forces a new line

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render (h2 by default)

props.name: mode
props.description:
letters: letters fade in from nothing in a scattered order.
dim: letters brighten from 35% in a scattered order.
words: words brighten from 35% one after another, in reading order.

props.name: range
props.description: where the reveal runs, as [start, end] percentages of the timeline's cover range

props.name: timeline
props.description: a parent's named view timeline to follow (e.g. "--my-stage"); the text's own by default
